evidence.evidence_text: In this paper, we introduce a novel Query-gUIded aTtention cOmpression (QUITO) method, which leverages attention of the question over the contexts to filter useless information.
We evaluate the QUITO using two widely-used datasets, namely, NaturalQuestions and ASQA.
